features.name: AI Functionality Across Microsoft Products
features.description: Microsoft has 150 products with AI functionality built in, and any custom-built things partners create will likely include AI going forward.
caveats: This is a broad statement about general product roadmap

features.name: BC Talent Program
features.description: A program focused on building the next generation of talent in the Business Central space, aimed at upskilling professionals in AI and growing the AI-ready workforce.
caveats: Program needs more participants; structure is still being developed

features.name: Partner Technical Upskilling in AI
features.description: Partners need to move beyond surface-level AI adoption and develop deep technical understanding of AI capabilities, including how to build custom solutions and integrate AI into extensions.
caveats: Industry-wide AI talent shortage makes hiring difficult; requires training existing staff

features.name: Collaborative Ecosystem for Problem Solving
features.description: Partners, ISPs, and Microsoft must work together as a community to identify and solve long-running customer problems that have not yet been solved, accelerating innovation through collaborative development.
caveats: Success depends on finding the right problems and assembling capable teams
